points.description: States that the collision domain diameter decreases (gets smaller / shrinks), not increases or stays the same.
States the decrease is by a factor of 10 (diameter becomes one tenth), e.g. about 300 m to 30 m. A wrong factor or wrong example figures cancel this point.
points.partial_credit: Factor of 10 implied only via a correct example (e.g. 300m to 30m) without stating the factor explicitly: half of this point

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the direction (decreases) and the exact factor (10, or e.g. 300 m to 30 m). Saying only 'it gets smaller' earns 0.5. Any wrong direction or wrong factor (e.g. 'increases', 'halves') earns nothing for that point; a wrong example figure inconsistent with a factor of 10 cancels P2.
